ValidationRule.description: Gas test results must be provided when gas test is required and completed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: Gas_Test_Required__c && Gas_Test_Completed__c && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Gas_Test_Result__c, 'Pass')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Gas_Test_Result__c, 'Fail')) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Gas_Test_Result__c, 'Not Required'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Gas Test Result (Pass/Fail) is required when gas test has been completed.
